$comment: Demo data package, part 5: document libraries for the whole company with folders and files. English documents are generated as one-page PDFs, Arabic ones as Markdown (the PDF standard fonts carry no Arabic). Fictional; files are found again by name.

documents.name: Employee handbook 2026.pdf
documents.author: layla
lines: Welcome to TeamBeats Demo Holding. This handbook explains how we work together.
1. Working hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 17:00 in the UAE and Egypt; Sunday to Thursday in Saudi Arabia.
2. Leave: 30 calendar days of annual leave a year, booked through the Leave request service.
3. Sick leave: tell your manager before 9:00 and add a medical certificate after two days.
4. Conduct: read and confirm the Code of conduct in your first week.
5. Your data: HR keeps your records private; see the Data protection policy.

documents.name: دليل الموظف 2026.md
documents.author: noura
lines: مرحبًا بك في مجموعة تيم بيتس التجريبية القابضة. يشرح هذا الدليل طريقة عملنا معًا.
1. ساعات العمل: من الاثنين إلى الجمعة من 8:00 حتى 17:00 في الإمارات ومصر، ومن الأحد إلى الخميس في السعودية.
2. الإجازات: 30 يومًا تقويميًا للإجازة السنوية، تُحجز عبر خدمة طلب إجازة.
3. الإجازة المرضية: أبلغ مديرك قبل 9:00 وأرفق تقريرًا طبيًا بعد يومين.
4. السلوك المهني: اقرأ مدونة السلوك وأكّد اطلاعك عليها في أسبوعك الأول.
5. بياناتك: تحافظ الموارد البشرية على سرية سجلاتك؛ راجع سياسة حماية البيانات.

documents.name: Medical insurance summary.pdf
documents.author: reem
lines: Cover: in-patient and out-patient care in the GCC and Egypt, with emergency cover worldwide.
Network: present your card at any network clinic; no payment up front.
Dependants: spouse and up to three children under 21.
Dental and optical: up to 2,500 AED a year each.
Claims outside the network: submit receipts within 90 days through the insurer's app.

documents.name: Leave policy at a glance.pdf
documents.author: noura
lines: Annual leave: 30 days. Carry over up to 10 days to the end of March.
Sick leave: up to 90 days a year on the terms of local law.
Compassionate leave: 5 days for close family.
Parental leave: 90 days for mothers, 10 days for fathers.
Public holidays follow the working calendar of your office.

documents.name: Q3 2026 management report.pdf
documents.author: ahmed
lines: Revenue: up 11 percent year on year.
Operating margin: 14.2 percent, up 1.1 points.
On-time delivery: 97 percent.
Headcount: 412 at 30 September.
Outlook: three new Riyadh contracts start in Q1 2027.

documents.name: Supplier invoice checklist.pdf
documents.author: fatima
lines: Before you send an invoice to Finance, check:
- It shows our legal name and tax registration number.
- It quotes the purchase order number.
- Amounts match the approved purchase request.
- The bank details match the supplier record.

documents.name: دليل مطالبات المصروفات.md
documents.author: fatima
lines: - قدّم المطالبة خلال 60 يومًا من تاريخ الصرف.
- أرفق إيصالًا لكل بند، صورة أو ملف PDF.
- يعتمد المدير المباشر المطالبة خلال يومي عمل.
- تُدفع المطالبات المعتمدة في الدفعة الأسبوعية كل يوم خميس.

documents.name: Jebel Ali hub site guide.pdf
documents.author: khalid
lines: Gate 1: staff and visitors. Gate 2: trucks only.
Warehouses A, B and C now share one roof under the hub.
Assembly point: car park P3, next to the fuel station.
Shuttle: leaves Gate 1 at 06:15, 06:45 and 18:20.

documents.name: Riyadh office move plan.pdf
documents.author: priya
lines: Move date: Sunday 11 January.
1 to 14 December: pack desks using Facilities crates.
8 January: IT moves network and printers.
New address: Building 4, King Abdullah Financial District (fictional).

documents.name: Forklift safety checklist.pdf
documents.author: marco
lines: Before every shift: brakes, horn, lights, forks, chains and tyres.
Never lift people on the forks.
Keep loads low when moving and look in the direction of travel.
Report any fault to the shift supervisor before use.

documents.name: إجراءات الإخلاء في حالات الطوارئ.md
documents.author: khalid
lines: 1. عند سماع الإنذار، أوقف العمل واترك أغراضك.
2. اتجه إلى أقرب مخرج طوارئ دون استخدام المصاعد.
3. توجه إلى نقطة التجمع وانتظر تعليمات مسؤول الإخلاء.
4. لا تعد إلى المبنى حتى يُعلن أنه آمن.

documents.name: Approved software list.pdf
documents.author: omar
lines: Office suite, email and calendar: installed on every laptop.
Diagram editor, PDF editor, screen recorder: on request through the Software request service.
Developer tools: for IT and approved analysts only.
Anything else: ask the service desk before installing.

documents.name: Printer setup.txt
documents.author: tariq
lines: 1. Open Settings, then Printers.
2. Choose Add printer and pick the one named after your floor, for example DXB-F14.
3. Print a test page. Badge in at the printer to release your documents.
